prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one extreme-close dialogue head portrait for a grounded medieval RPG.
Input images: Image 1 is Sena's previous identity and costume master ONLY. Keep her recognizable short charcoal-gray hair with the single broad silver forelock, dark blue robe and cream scarf, and contemplative sidelong look, but correct its youthful chibi face and oversized eyes to match the CURRENT canonical age around fifty. Images 2 (Mara), 3 (Ivo), 4 (Leiya), 5 (Tor) are approved PORTRAIT STYLE masters only. Follow their close framing, serious mature face structure and hard-edged pixel clusters, not their face identities.
Primary request: redraw Sena Reed (塞娜·里德, NPC-SENA / NPC08), an archivist woman around fifty, as a single logical 74-pixel-wide by 100-pixel-high portrait. If larger output is needed, emulate an integer nearest-neighbor enlargement of that coarse grid. Avoid fine painted texture for subsequent shrinking.
Identity and expression: distinct woman with an oval slightly angular face, a longer narrow nose with visible bridge and nostril-wing plane, clear cheekbone structure, gently firmer lower face, quiet mature eyes, subtly slanted serious brows and a small pressed closed mouth. Face angled modestly toward viewer-left and eyes cast sideways left, thinking and quietly tired. Restrained small under-eye planes, a little softening of lower cheek and one brow crease convey about fifty naturally. Not an elderly crone, not a young girl, not seductive, not a smirking conspirator. She is calm, self-contained and observant. Hair is SHORT jaw-length charcoal-gray bob with a SINGLE prominent broad SILVER forehead sweep at viewer-left/front, not a ponytail, braid or bun. Form 4 or 5 connected, substantial matte locks, no flyaway strands or shiny black waves.
Framing: EXTREME CLOSE HEAD; hair crown just inside the top, cheeks occupy width, chin near the lower edge. Entire hair head silhouette fills about 95 percent of the frame height; only a narrow strip of cream scarf and dark muted blue archivist over-robe appears at bottom. Almost no visible neck, no large shoulders or chest. Preserve dark BLUE robe not brown, and cream scarf, with only simple large folds. No books, bag, hands or papers in frame.
Style: adult anatomy matching the approved Mara/Ivo/Leiya/Tor portraits, large connected hard-edged low-resolution pixel clusters. Strong warm dark silhouette contour; muted warm terracotta skin with coherent midtones and brown shadow planes; clear angular nose bridge, nostrils, cheekbones, lower lip. Small narrow deep-set eyes, dark iris with merely a tiny muted ivory side sliver, no giant white sclera or shiny pupils. At most 32 visible RGB colors for this batch; flat color ramps, no gradients, airbrush, antialiasing, noise, dithering, scattered texture pixels, single hair lines or decorative lashes.
True transparent alpha outside silhouette. Single person, one portrait, no text, border, frame, background, panels, UI, jewelry, badges, conspirator symbols or magically glowing eyes.
